notes: Require a confirmed repository path in a POSIX shell. Do not scan every directory to locate a repository.
--untracked-files=no intentionally omits untracked files; do not claim the worktree is completely clean from this snapshot.
Use --no-ext-diff and --no-textconv for content diffs so repository-configured external diff helpers are not invoked.
Do not print remote URLs, config credentials, .env files, or credential stores.
Never checkout, restore, reset, clean, rebase, commit, push, fetch, or run hooks/builds/tests merely to inspect code.
